description: Directed evidence graph for one DTC family. Scoring: diagnostic_score(h) ∝ prior(h) × Π evidence multipliers from completed tests. Scores are uncalibrated expert weights, NOT calibrated probabilities: correlated rules from a single measurement are deduplicated via evidence_group, and the outcome dataset will calibrate them later.

code_context.description: How co-occurring DTCs reshape this graph's hypotheses. Applied to every graph that matches any present code; the engine scores all matched graphs and returns them ranked.

dtcs.description: DTCs that route a session to this graph.

explanation.description: Plain-language statement of what the ECU observed. Must not name a failed part.

repairs.description: Repair ACTIONS, never SKUs. SKU/guide/video resolution is the fitment service's job (backend/app/fitment.py), keyed off action + VIN.

action.description: Machine-readable repair action, e.g. replace_intake_pcv_hose. Resolved to a VIN-specific SKU by the fitment service.

min_confidence.description: Only offered once the top hypothesis reaches at least this band.

recommendation_class.description: diagnostic: a next step (inspect, test) — guidance, never a part sale. replacement: a part/service the retailer can sell — gated by requires_any evidence.

requires_any.description: Evidence that must exist before a replacement-class repair is offered: test ids ('inspect_intake') or test_id:outcome ('inspect_intake:leak_found'). At least one entry must be satisfiable without planned signals.

verification.description: How to confirm the repair worked: rescan, drive cycles, monitor readiness.

stop_if.description: Observation flags that end diagnosis immediately with a stop-driving message.

signals.description: Measurement recipes: HOW the app acquires each derived field a rule reads. The bridge between the graph's conceptual evidence and the OBD transport. Every obd_live test must reference declared signals; every derived field used in a when-rule should come from one.

conditions.description: Acquisition conditions, e.g. rpm range or cold-start requirement.

derived.description: Field names this recipe produces — the names when-rules reference.

pids.description: Mode 01/02 PIDs (two-char hex). Empty for services without PIDs.

service.description: OBD service as hex string: '01' live data, '02' freeze frame, '06' onboard monitoring, '09' vehicle info.

signal.description: Stable recipe id referenced by tests.

status.description: supported: the transport can acquire this today (capability checker verifies). planned: not yet implemented — tests using only planned signals cannot gate a replacement repair.

tests.description: Ordered cheapest-first. The engine runs the first untested one as 'next test'.

outcomes.description: Categorical outcomes for guided tests. Preferred over updates_if_yes: a 'no' answer is evidence too (e.g. coil_swap staying on the cylinder down-weights the coil).

reads.description: DEPRECATED: conceptual signal names. Use signals (measurement recipes) instead.

evidence_group.description: Rules sharing a group come from ONE measurement. Per hypothesis, only the strongest |log multiplier| in the group applies; the rest are reported as deduped, never multiplied.

updates.description: Evidence multipliers keyed by hypothesis id, applied when the rule matches.

when.description: Boolean expression over the observation fields, e.g. 'trim_idle - trim_2500 >= 8'.

signals.description: Measurement recipe ids (from top-level signals) this obd_live test acquires.

updates_if_yes.description: Legacy boolean path: multipliers applied when the user answers yes. Kept for backward compatibility; outcomes is preferred.

title.description: Human title for the fault family.
